_comment: Copy to persona.config.json (gitignored) and edit. Each entry defines one persona this bot can act as; the active one is selected via the BOT_PERSONA env var. The config file path can also be overridden with the RHI_PERSONA_CONFIG env var. All fields except `name` are OPTIONAL — anything omitted is derived generically from the persona name and your home directory (see field docs below).

personas.name: aria
personas._doc_vesselDir: Working dir for the spawned Claude. Holds the persona's CLAUDE.md / prompts / state. Default: ~/.claude/relvetia/<name>
personas._doc_soulDir: Where the persona's long-form memory lives. Default: ~/.claude/memory/<name>
personas._doc_discordWakePath: Markdown file used as the system prompt when the persona wakes for Discord. Default: <vesselDir>/prompts/discord-wake.md
personas._doc_env: Extra env vars injected into the spawned Claude subprocess. Default: { RELVETIA_INCLUDE_<NAME>: "1" }
personas._doc_additionalDirs: Dirs the spawned Claude may read/write (--add-dir). Keep these scoped to THIS persona's own memory dir plus shared roots; do not include another persona's memory dir.
personas._doc_sessionStateDir: Where per-guild session state JSON files live. Default: <vesselDir>/state/discord-sessions

personas._comment: Minimal entry — only `name` is set; every other field is derived generically (e.g. vesselDir = ~/.claude/relvetia/nova, env = { RELVETIA_INCLUDE_NOVA: "1" }).
personas.name: nova
